title: [GMCP 203.006.05] Interoperability and quality: Production-grade Streamable HTTP transport
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-006-05. Prove applicable official-suite and reference-SDK interoperability in both roles, direct-versus-gateway differential behavior, property invariants, transport and platform parity, and published latency, throughput, startup, memory, disk, and fairness budgets. Retain regression fixtures for every incompatibility found. Vector outcome: GMCP serves and consumes current Streamable HTTP over HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 with correct POST semantics, media negotiation, streaming and non-streaming responses, origin/host validation, protocol and method headers, cache controls, cancellation, backpressure, connection limits, TLS, proxy awareness, and graceful drain. Removed GET/SSE-resume/session behavior is rejected on the modern path and confined to explicit legacy adapters. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
